ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all shareholders, directors, attorneys-in-fact and ultimate beneficial owners against the OFAC SDN, UN Security Council consolidated list, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, Spanish Ministry of Economy and Finance (CNA) and SEPBLAC records, and Spanish domestic PEP databases. Screening must occur before name reservation, notarization, and submission to the Registro Mercantil, and must be repeated on an ongoing basis under Ley 10/2010 arts. 3 and 4. Low-Risk Standard AI API business triggers simplified due diligence but PEP detection remains mandatory; enhanced measures apply if crypto payment rails or high-risk jurisdiction involved.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central (RMC) – Denominaciones Sociales; online via https://www.registradores.org/registro-mercantil-central/denominaciones-sociales and CIRCE at https://www.circe.es
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All proposed names must be in Spanish or, where using foreign words, rendered in Latin script with Spanish transliteration. The name must be admissible under art. 7 LSC, not identical or confusingly similar to prior registered denominations. For an S.L., the name must end with 'Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada' or 'S.L.'. Spanish letters with accents, ñ, and special diacritics are permitted; non-Latin scripts require Latin transliteration. The name must not contain indications of another corporate type.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco, crédito, seguro, reaseguro, fondos de pensiones, fondos de inversión, entidades financieras (requires authorization of Banco de España and/or Ministry of Finance)
Bolsa, mercado de valores, broker, corredor (requires CNMV authorization)
España, Madrid, Catalonia, or other territorial names (requires ministerial or autonomous community administrative authorization)
S.A., Sociedad Anónima, S.C., limited partnership tokens incompatible with an S.L. designation
Nacional, Real, Estatal, Oficial, Pública, Ministerio (requires express State authorization)
Ondas, radio, televisión, telecomunicaciones (requires Ministry authorization if regulated)
Any expression contrary to law, public order, morality, or good custom
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the RMC issues a negative certificate rejecting the proposed name, the applicant may file a motion for reconsideration (recurso de reposición) with the RMC, and thereafter an administrative appeal (recurso de alzada) before the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública of the Ministry of Justice within one (1) month of notification. Alternatively, the applicant may immediately file a new name certificate application. A successful reservation must be used in the notarial deed and commercial registry filing within the 90-day validity window; no extension exists except by issuing a new certificate.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is permissible as an administrative address only if there is a genuine physical location located in Spain staffed during regular business hours where registered mail, books and records can be served; mere PO Box or co-working address without legal domicile capacity is not accepted. For an AI/LLM API platform with no physical retail presence, use of a serviced office or legal agent is acceptable provided it qualifies as a 'domicilio social' under art. 9 LSC and commercial registry guidelines.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (less than 10%) for a low-risk administrative AI/LLM API company, but the risk rises to approximately 20-30% if SEPBLAC or tax authorities receive red flags from crypto (USDC) inflows, lack of physical presence, or nominee directors.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Royal Legislative Decree 1/2010 of 2 July, approving the consolidated text of the Spanish Companies Act (Ley de Sociedades de Capital, 'LSC'): Articles 20 (public deed), 22 (minimum share capital), 26-29 (subscription and payment), 30 (formation in process), 32-33 (registration in the Mercantile Registry), 34 (bylaws), 62 (shares), 209 (administrators). Notarial and registry fees are charged per official government tariffs (aranceles), approximately EUR 150-200 for a minimum-capital SL.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial (Provincial Mercantile Registry) of the province where the registered office is located; Registro Mercantil Central (Central Mercantile Registry, Madrid) for name certification (certificación negativa de denominación).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (public notarial deed of incorporation) followed by inscripción obligatoria in the Registro Mercantil (mandatory registration of the company).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Standard SL minimum capital is EUR 3,000 (Article 4 LSC), fully subscribed and paid up in cash at incorporation. The capital may be deposited by means of an escrow/blocked account (certificado de depósito) opened in the name of 'SL en formación' and released only upon registration; non-cash contributions require an expert valuation report (Article 73 LSC). Under Law 18/2022 (Ley Crea y Crece), an SL de Formación Sucesiva may be formed with capital from EUR 1 up to EUR 3,000, subject to legal reserve and distribution restrictions until the minimum is reached.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: UNANIMOUS RESOLUTION OF THE FOUNDING MEMBERS - RESOLUTION NO. 1: (1) Subscription and full payment in cash of 3,000 shares of EUR 1.00 par value each, representing the entire share capital, pursuant to Articles 22, 58 and 62 LSC. (2) Adoption of the Articles of Association (estatutos sociales), whose corporate purpose covers generative AI and LLM inference API platform services (CNAE 6201). (3) Fixing of the registered office at Madrid. (4) Appointment of the sole administrator with full powers. (5) Authorization to obtain the name certificate, execute the public deed, complete bank compliance, and file for registration in the Mercantile Registry. Approved unanimously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain negative name certificate (Certificación Negativa de Denominación Social)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (Central Mercantile Registry), Madrid - online application via the Colegio de Registradores portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a formal application requesting certification that the proposed company name is not identical to an existing company. Provide three alternative names in order of preference. The certificate is valid for three months and must be attached to the notarial deed.
required_dossiers: Copy of passport or NIE of each founding member
Proposed corporate name with three alternatives
Payment of the official certification fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry reports the name as unavailable, promptly resubmit the application with additional alternative names; if the certificate expires, renew it before the deed execution date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open corporate bank account and deposit the share capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized credit institution (bank) regulated by the Banco de España; capital deposit certificate issued by the bank.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a bank account under the name 'Sociedad en constitución' and deposit the minimum paid-up capital (EUR 3,000 or the chosen amount). Obtain a certificate of deposit (certificado de depósito) expressly stating the account holder, deposited amount, and restriction on withdrawal before registration. Alternatively, non-cash contributions may be used subject to an expert valuation report under Article 73 LSC.
required_dossiers: Passport or NIE of each shareholder
Beneficial ownership and anti-money laundering declarations (bank KYC forms)
Confirmation of economic activity and source of funds
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank raises KYC or beneficial ownership queries, provide additional corporate and source-of-funds documentation; if the bank refuses the file, transfer the deposit to another authorized credit institution and obtain a new certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute the public deed of incorporation before a notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary public (Notaría) within the territorial College of Notaries; the notary transmits the deed electronically to the tax authorities for the provisional NIF.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: All founding members (or their legal representatives) appear before the notary and execute the escritura de constitución. The deed must contain the shareholders' identity, the capital and shares, the adopted articles of association, the registered office, the corporate purpose, and the appointed administrators. The notary will pay the official notarial tariff and simultaneously request the provisional NIF. Ensure the name certificate and bank deposit certificate are attached to the deed.
required_dossiers: Passport or NIE of each founding member and administrator
Name, address and CNAE code of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary detects statutory defects or inconsistencies, correct the deed in a supplementary public instrument (acta complementaria) or re-execute the deed before the same notary without additional substantive cost.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pay the Transfer Tax and Stamp Duty (ITPAJD) and obtain the provisional NIF
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) for the NIF; the competent Autonomous Community tax agency for ITPAJD (e.g., Agencia Tributaria de la Comunidad de Madrid), self-liquidating system.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the first copy (copia autorizada) of the deed to the tax office and self-assess the corporate transactions modality (modalidad operaciones societarias) of ITPAJD at the statutory rate of 1% of the share capital. Apply for the provisional NIF using the deed and form 036/037. The company may now execute contracts and open accounts, but its limited liability to third parties attaches only after Mercantile Registry registration.
required_dossiers: First authorized copy of the public deed
Form 036/037 (tax registration) with provisional NIF application
Identity documentation of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax office queries the beneficial ownership or the deed content, file clarifications through the registered electronic office; any overpayment can be corrected via a supplementary or refund filing within the statutory period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the company in the Provincial Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial (Provincial Mercantile Registry) corresponding to the registered office address (e.g., Mercantile Registry of Madrid).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the corporate deed with the Provincial Mercantile Registry within the two-month legal term (or via the notary's telematic channel). Registry examiners verify formal and legal compliance. Upon approval, the company is inscribed and acquires legal personality. Obtain a registry certificate (certificación registral) evidencing the incorporation.
required_dossiers: First copy of the public deed of incorporation
Bank certificate of capital deposit (if not already incorporated in the deed)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar withholds registration due to defects, rectify the defect and re-present the deed within the validity period of the instrument. The deed may not be presented after two years from execution unless re-validated; if the certificate of deposit lapses, renew the blocked deposit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration formalities: definitive NIF, IAE registration, books, social security and data protection
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT); Provincial Mercantile Registry (booking legalization); Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS); the corresponding Ayuntamiento (municipal activity communication); Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (AEPD).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registration, apply to AEAT to convert the provisional NIF into the definitive NIF by presenting the registry certificate. File the economic activity registration (modelo 036) confirming the IAE/CNAE 6201 classification. Register as an employer with the TGSS. Legalize the corporate and accounting books at the Mercantile Registry. Submit the municipal declaración responsable / comunicación previa de actividad for office use. For the AI/LLM API business, register personal data processing records with the AEPD and adopt the GDPR Article 30 processing register.
required_dossiers: AEPD data processing registration and GDPR policies
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipal authority objects to the activity classification, amend the communication or adjust the office premises to meet local zoning requirements; any AEPD or TGSS query must be answered within the administrative deadline to avoid penalties.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - the AI/LLM API platform business (CNAE 6201 / ISIC 6201) is a purely digital service activity. No industrial license is triggered; the competent authority for economic activity in Spain would be the Consejería de Economía, Hacienda y Empleo of the relevant Autonomous Community only in the rare case of physical data-center infrastructure.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required - 'Licencia de actividad' is not mandated for software/cloud service providers. A municipal declaración responsable / comunicación previa de actividad for office premises may be required, together with compliance with data protection (GDPR) and, if applicable, a simple AEPD appointment of a Data Protection Officer.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico (MITECO); in autonomous communities with devolved competence, the regional environmental authority.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - the activity is digital and office-based and does not fall within Annexes I or II of Law 21/2013 on Environmental Assessment; no EIA report, simplified environmental assessment, or prior environmental registration is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable - the business generates no industrial wastewater, VOC emissions, or hazardous waste streams. General office waste handling obligations under Law 7/2022 (Waste and Contaminated Soils) apply, including the segregation of electronic scrap and delivery to authorized managers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety compliance for office premises under Royal Decree 513/2017 (Reglamento de Seguridad contra Incendios en Establecimientos Industriales and the applicable municipal fire code); structural/electrical load inspections where the town hall's declaración responsable requires them; occupational risk prevention plan and workplace risk assessment under Law 31/1995 (Ley de Prevención de Riesgos Laborales); employer registration with the TGSS; appropriate civil liability and IT insurance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), official portal: https://www.agenciatributaria.gob.es
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities obtain Spanish NIF by applying online via AEAT portal or in person at tax offices, providing identification documents, proof of address, and incorporation documents. Subsequent VAT registration follows if applicable.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Absence of check-the-box; non-residents subject to hybrid mismatch and CFC rules under Spanish tax law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory use of electronic invoicing (Facturae) for B2B; real-time VAT reporting and digital stamping via AEAT systems.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT applies to exports of goods to non-EU countries and certain offshore services, subject to proof of export and non-EU destination.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent zero-rating claims result in 100% tax surcharge, administrative fines up to €600,000, and potential criminal liability with retrospective VAT clawback and interest.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain) as the national competent authority for banking supervision, Balance of Payments statistics and AML/CFT inspection, operating under European Central Bank (ECB) oversight; foreign exchange and foreign investment control authority: Secretaría de Estado de Comercio - Dirección General de Comercio Internacional e Inversiones (DGCIIN), Ministry of Industry, Trade and Tourism; specialized AML/KYC supervision and national risk coordination: SEPBLAC (Servicio Ejecutivo de la Comisión de Prevención del Blanqueo de Capitales e Infracciones Monetarias).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full current-account and capital-account convertibility under Articles 63-66 TFEU; Spain imposes no exchange-control authorization, surrender, or prior approval on EUR-denominated AI/LLM API service export collections, dividend remittances, or non-resident shareholder capital contributions. Remaining obligations are statistical and prudential: (i) Balance of Payments Form TE reporting under Banco de España Circular 4/2012 for non-resident flows equal to or above EUR 50,000 per operation, or cumulative annual flows equal to or above EUR 250,000; and (ii) foreign-investment screening under Law 19/2003 and Royal Decree 571/2023, triggerable only where a non-EU/EU foreign-government-controlled investor acquires 10%+ control of an entity in a regulated strategic sector or critical-technology area - not applicable to the standard SL non-controlling ownership of an AI-API platform. Dividend and profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are unencumbered from a treasury standpoint, subject solely to the 19% non-resident dividend withholding tax (lower under applicable DTT or 0% under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive when the parent holds at least 10%).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None: Spain applies a 0% mandatory conversion ratio for export proceeds and no statutory repatriation timeline; export invoices for AI/LLM API services may be collected and retained indefinitely in foreign currency within Spanish bank multi-currency accounts (USD, GBP, MXN). Statutory compliance gates are limited to: (i) monthly Balance of Payments Form TE declaration, due by the 15th day of the month following the reference month when the EUR 50,000 single-operation threshold is crossed; (ii) Modelo 720 annual foreign-assets disclosure if offshore deposit or USDC-custody balances exceed EUR 50,000 per account class; and (iii) bank-level declaration of the purpose code 'S6' (servicios de informática y de información) at each collection. Intercompany export credits extended beyond 6 months without interest must be documented by an executed intercompany loan or credit-term agreement to survive transfer-pricing scrutiny.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (Cuenta de Depósito de Desembolso) + Operational Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: MEDIUM for EU-passported and Spanish-licensed electronic money institutions (e.g., Wise Platform, Revolut Business, Pismo-backed neobanks) operating under Law 21/2011 and PSD2: fully viable as secondary EUR collection and payout rails but non-viable as the sole operational account because they cannot issue the notarial certificado de desembolso for the capital-escrow step and lack registered-office corporate banking features. LOW for non-EU EMIs (UK, US, Cayman): they are treated as foreign financial accounts subject to Modelo 720 and are systematically de-risked by Spanish correspondent banks when the beneficial owner is a Spanish NIF-holding corporate; USDC conversion must be executed only through a Banco de España-registered VASP/EDE under Law 10/2010 as amended by Law 6/2023, never through an unlicensed offshore exchange.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Standard Tier-1 mandate: one physical appearance at a branch by the sole administrator (director) holding the original NIE certificate and passport, or, alternatively, by a legal representative under a notarized power of attorney - apostilled under the 1961 Hague Convention and translated into Spanish by a sworn translator (traductor jurado). Completely remote onboarding is accepted only where the director holds a Spanish DNIe or advanced digital certificate and passes the bank's video-identification flow; Banco de Sabadell and Bankinter support full digital opening, while Santander, BBVA and CaixaBank require the first signing of the corporate mandate at a branch. No standalone KYC interview is statutorily required by Law 10/2010, but the bank's compliance team routinely conducts an onboarding call to validate the AI-API commercial model, the USD/Stripe collection flow, and the non-resident client base.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident director or beneficial owner resident in a FATF red-flag or enhanced-monitoring jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled certificate of tax residence; three-month personal bank statements evidencing source of funds; certified passport; professional CV; notarial deed of incorporation of the SL; Registro Mercantil hoja registral extract; written source-of-wealth and source-of-funds letter addressed to the bank's compliance department.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: USDC / cryptocurrency inflows flagged as possible unauthorized VASP activity or crypto-tainted funds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution irrevocably adopting EUR-first invoicing through Stripe; contractual prohibition of token payment in the user terms; treasury policy requiring conversion of any incidental USDC to EUR within 24 hours through a Banco de España-registered VASP; complete swap audit trail with blockchain transaction identifiers; corporate statement confirming the SL does not act as custodian or exchanger under Law 10/2010.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly incorporated SL (under 90 days) with high projected transaction velocity and 100% non-resident client base
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed AI/LLM API license agreements or letters of intent with launch customers; developer dashboard evidence of pre-launch usage; 12-month cash-flow forecast in the bank's template; incorporation deed and NIE of all administrators; Stripe KYB verification output and historical settlement schedules of the founder's prior platforms.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border outbound payments to contractors and cloud providers in higher-risk corridors (LatAm data centers, freelance developers resident in MX/CO/BR)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed service agreements with defined deliverables; supplier invoices bearing local tax registration numbers (NIT, RFC, CUIL); supplier onboarding KYC questionnaire in the bank's proprietary format; transfer-pricing documentation and an arm's-length rate card for AI-engineering and subcontracted API development services.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital (statutory minimum EUR 3,000) is wired by SWIFT MT103 into the bank-designated capital escrow account (cuenta de depósito de desembolso) citing purpose code K1 (inversión directa - aportación de capital) and the incorporation deed reference; the bank issues the certificado de desembolso to the notary, and after inscription in the Registro Mercantil the funds are unblocked into the operational account. Client receivables and Stripe EUR settlements arrive by SEPA Credit Transfer (IBAN) or SWIFT MT103 gpi from non-EEA payers citing purpose code S6; the bank retains the AI/LLM API license invoices evidencing VAT treatment (reverse charge or 0% export-of-services for non-EU B2B customers) and the registration in the TE statistical returns. Any inbound intercompany credit from a foreign parent must use purpose code K4 and be accompanied by a fully executed intercompany loan agreement with approved interest-rate documentation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rails: (i) SEPA Instant Credit Transfer (SCT Inst) for recurring EUR supplier payments under EUR 100,000; (ii) SWIFT MT103 gpi for non-EEA disbursements (U.S. beneficiaries via ABA/RTN, LatAm correspondents) with purpose codes S6 (cloud compute, API infrastructure, hosting), S7 (software library royalties and IP licenses), or S8 (subcontracted AI development and other business services); and (iii) SWIFT MT202 COVER for USD/EUR correspondent clearing where the beneficiary bank lacks a direct SWIFT relationship. Commercial letters of credit (LC) are institutionally available from all Tier-1 Spanish banks but commercially inapplicable to AI API transactions due to the absence of physical-goods documentary evidence; the platform treasury should operate open-account MT103 payment flows with dual-approval controls, batch release workflows and automated FX-trigger monitoring.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla EUR/USD deliverable FX forwards with tenors up to 12 months under the bank's ISDA 2002 master agreement or the bank's published FX master terms

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on Latin American convertibility-limited currencies (MXN, BRL, COP, CLP, ARS) executed only with Banco de España-authorized credit institutions, settled in USD or EUR and subject to EMIR reporting to an ESMA-registered trade repository

Cross-currency swaps (CIRS) aligning USD-denominated API revenue with EUR-denominated payroll and cloud operating expenditure, with maturity matched to the hyperscaler (AWS/Azure/GCP) contract lifecycle

European-style currency options and zero-cost collars on EUR/USD to protect the LatAm expansion budget, permitted where the board designates the strategy as hedge-only under the company's documented FX risk policy

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada management body; subsequent filing with the competent Provincial Mercantile Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Prepare within three months after the financial year-end; approve within six months after year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to prepare or approve accounts may support director liability and regulatory enforcement; filing delay is subject to Mercantile Registry filing sanctions and possible registry closure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after approval; for a calendar-year company normally by 31 July if accounts are approved by 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines generally range from EUR 1,200 to EUR 60,000 and may reach EUR 300,000 for companies with annual turnover exceeding EUR 6 million; registry closure may occur after one year of non-filing and may prevent registration of most subsequent corporate acts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submitted with the annual accounts deposit; update promptly when beneficial ownership or control changes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Incorrect, incomplete, or omitted beneficial ownership information may result in filing rejection, registry closure, administrative penalties, and potential liability for directors and the declarant.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Legalization of accounting and corporate books
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the financial year-end, normally by 30 April for a calendar-year company; electronic legalization is standard
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or omitted legalization may impair evidentiary value and expose directors to compliance and record-keeping liability; the Registry may reject defective submissions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Spanish State Tax Administration Agency (Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within the first 25 calendar days following the six-month period after the tax year-end; normally 1-25 July for a calendar-year company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Voluntary late filing generally triggers a surcharge of 1% plus 1% for each additional complete month up to 12 months; thereafter a 15% surcharge plus late-payment interest may apply. Failure with tax due may trigger a penalty generally ranging from 50% to 150% of the unpaid amount.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual VAT summary return, Modelo 390, where applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally due during the first 30 calendar days of January following the calendar year; exceptions apply to taxpayers exempt from filing the annual summary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or omitted filing may result in fixed or proportional tax penalties, late-payment surcharges, interest, and assessment of undeclared VAT.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual withholding and prepayment summary, Modelo 190, where applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally due from 1 to 31 January following the calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or omitted filing may trigger penalties for failure to submit information returns and separate liability for unpaid withholding or prepayments, including interest and surcharges.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent audit is generally mandatory when the company exceeds at least two of the following thresholds for two consecutive financial years: EUR 2.85 million total assets, EUR 5.7 million annual net turnover, or 50 average employees. Additional mandates apply to certain regulated entities, entities receiving specified subsidies, entities issuing securities, and groups requiring audited consolidated accounts.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish General Accounting Plan (Plan General de Contabilidad) and applicable Spanish commercial-law rules; IFRS is generally required for listed consolidated accounts and may apply to certain consolidated groups. The SL's statutory individual accounts are normally prepared under Spanish GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The annual accounts filing must identify the ultimate beneficial owner, generally an individual holding directly or indirectly more than 25% of capital or voting rights or exercising control by other means. Changes must be reflected in the company's internal ownership records and reported through the applicable Mercantile Registry filing. Share transfers must be documented and recorded in the Register of Members; there is no separate annual franchise-style UBO renewal.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of contracts with the sole shareholder, if applicable
Legalized accounting books, including the journal and inventory and annual accounts book
Beneficial ownership information and supporting ownership-control records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350-1,500 per year for a registered office, corporate administration, and filing support package; Spain does not generally impose a separate annual registered-agent renewal fee.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000-12,000 for a typical audited Spanish SL; substantially higher fees may apply to regulated, multinational, consolidated, or complex technology businesses.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: R&D tax credits (up to 25% of eligible expenses), innovation aid programs, and temporary reductions for reinvested profits

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 100 - Corporate Income Tax Return via AEAT electronic portal (sede.aeat.gob.es)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 25th day of the 4th month following the end of the fiscal year (e.g. 25 April for calendar year-end 31 December)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income after all adjustments and deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents include permanent establishment income; file with supporting TRC documentation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Withholding taxes paid on dividends, interest and royalties
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents must self-assess and remit WHT on outbound distributions

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 100-500 EUR per day up to 5,000 EUR; criminal sanctions for evasion

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Submit TRC (Treaty Relief Certificate) application to AEAT with ownership, residency and beneficial ownership documentation to claim reduced rates under applicable double tax treaties
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 19% statutory rate, reduced to 0-10% under treaties (e.g. US, EU); Interest: 19% statutory rate, frequently 0% under treaties for related-party debt

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EUR 20 million annual group turnover for mandatory Local File and Master File
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Mandatory under Spanish Economic Substance Regulations for IP holding, distribution and service entities; requires adequate local employees, assets and core income-generating activities

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to declare income or deliberate inflation of deductible expenses
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties: fines up to 100% of evaded tax plus imprisonment up to 5 years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing the corporate veil; directors face personal criminal liability, fines and disqualification

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining an SL without genuine economic activity or substance in Spain
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Company dissolution, fines up to EUR 600,000 and potential fraud charges
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Imprisonment up to 6 years, travel bans and restitution orders

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file suspicious transaction reports or comply with KYC for crypto-related payments
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to EUR 1 million or 2% of annual turnover plus criminal prosecution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal fines, imprisonment and permanent disqualification from management roles
